name: @tavern-chat/web
description: TavernChat 极简多端前端（Web / Android Capacitor APK / Electron 桌面端共享）

scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && node -e "import('node:child_process').then(cp => process.exit(cp.spawnSync('rspack', ['build', '-c', 'rspack.config.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'production' } }).status ?? 1))"
scripts.apk:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
